notes: The author self-declares an rp and you play as a pig, so Roleplay & Avatar Sim leads and the Animal Sim preset applies: wilderness-open is the farm-and-forest holding you wander as a creature, and den-shelter is the shed you buy and return to, sited in the fixed home area the answers specified rather than on a plot you place. Simulation is named second only for its options, since berries are a gathered currency spent on skins and the shed - that gives collectible-nodes for the berry nodes and reads social-hub as the upgrades storefront the preset already wanted. Kept the scale small per the answers, a compact holding with a forest edge, so no distance-scaled regions and no separate maps. I assumed without asking that the shed and farm buildings are exteriors only, since the answers called the housing simple, which keeps this off P3 and entirely on P0.
